Not verified: DHCR Brooklyn PDF truncated before 11211/11222/11249; building RS counts for 197 Franklin and 228 Kingsland not found. 245 W 109th #11 and 542 E 79th #5S still unreviewed.

Manual follow-up run 4 min after the morning scan; search pages unchanged (not re-fetched). Verified: 228 Kingsland #1M -> score 40 (building history market-like, RS claim only via Craigslist); 380 S 4th #2S -> building RS confirmed again, unit unknown. Still unverifiable: Dupont St and Hewes St Craigslist posts (no street numbers); 219 Franklin #4 not re-checked.
